description: This file implements the packet handling logic for Git's protocol, including functions for creating, sending, receiving, and tracing packets over a network or file descriptor. It manages packet formatting, flushing, sideband multiplexing, and reading/writing packet data according to Git's wire protocol.

classes.name: struct packet_reader
classes.description: Encapsulates the state for reading packets from a file descriptor, including buffers, options, and parse status.

classes.name: struct packet_writer
classes.description: Encapsulates the state for writing packets to a file descriptor, including sideband use and destination fd.

methods.name: void packet_trace_identity(const char * prog)
methods.description: Sets the trace prefix for packet tracing, duplicating the given program name string.

methods.name: const char * get_trace_prefix(void)
methods.description: Returns the current trace prefix, based on whether asynchronous I/O is used.

methods.name: int packet_trace_pack(const char * buf,unsigned int len,int sideband)
methods.description: Traces a packet if sideband or pack tracing is enabled.

methods.name: void packet_trace(const char * buf,unsigned int len,int write)
methods.description: Main function to trace packets, including handling of special PACK markers, formatting, and output.

methods.name: void packet_flush(int fd)
methods.description: Sends a flush packet ('0000') over the given fd, with tracing.

methods.name: void packet_delim(int fd)
methods.description: Sends a delimiter packet ('0001') over the fd, with tracing.

methods.name: void packet_response_end(int fd)
methods.description: Sends a response end packet ('0002') over the fd, with tracing.

methods.name: int packet_flush_gently(int fd)
methods.description: Attempts to flush a flush packet gently, returns error indicator.

methods.name: void packet_buf_flush(struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Adds a flush packet to the given strbuf.

methods.name: void packet_buf_delim(struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Adds a delimiter packet to the given strbuf.

methods.name: void set_packet_header(char * buf,int size)
methods.description: Sets the packet length header based on size, encoding size as 4 hex characters.

methods.name: void format_packet(struct strbuf * out,const char * prefix,const char * fmt,va_list args)
methods.description: Formats a packet with a prefix and formatted message, prepending with header and tracing.

methods.name: int packet_write_fmt_1(int fd,int gently,const char * prefix,const char * fmt,va_list args)
methods.description: Writes a formatted packet with a prefix over a file descriptor, optionally gently.

methods.name: void packet_write_fmt(int fd,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Variadic function to write a formatted packet.

methods.name: int packet_write_fmt_gently(int fd,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Variant that attempts to write a formatted packet gently, returning success/failure.

methods.name: int do_packet_write(const int fd_out,const char * buf,size_t size,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Performs the actual write of packet data to a file descriptor, with header and error reporting.

methods.name: int packet_write_gently(const int fd_out,const char * buf,size_t size)
methods.description: Wrapper over do_packet_write to attempt gentle write.

methods.name: void packet_write(int fd_out,const char * buf,size_t size)
methods.description: Writes a packet and aborts on failure.

methods.name: void packet_fwrite(FILE * f,const char * buf,size_t size)
methods.description: Fwrites a packet to a FILE*, including header and tracing.

methods.name: void packet_fwrite_fmt(FILE * fh,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats and writes a packet to FILE*.

methods.name: void packet_fflush(FILE * f)
methods.description: Flushes a packet to a FILE*, including tracing.

methods.name: void packet_buf_write(struct strbuf * buf,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats a packet and appends it to a strbuf.

methods.name: int write_packetized_from_fd_no_flush(int fd_in,int fd_out)
methods.description: Reads data from a source fd and packets it, writing to a destination fd, no flush.

methods.name: int write_packetized_from_buf_no_flush_count(const char * src_in,size_t len,int fd_out,int * packet_counter)
methods.description: Packets data from a buffer, counting packets, no flush.

methods.name: int get_packet_data(int fd,char ** src_buf,size_t * src_size,void * dst,size_t size,int options)
methods.description: Reads packet data from fd or buffer, handling errors and options.

methods.name: int packet_length(const char lenbuf_hex[4],size_t size)
methods.description: Decodes a 4-byte hex header into packet length.

methods.name: char * find_packfile_uri_path(const char * buffer)
methods.description: Finds a packfile URI path within a buffer.

methods.name: enum:packet_read_status packet_read_with_status(int fd,char ** src_buffer,size_t * src_len,char * buffer,unsigned size,int * pktlen,int options)
methods.description: Reads a packet and returns status, handling sideband and errors.

methods.name: int packet_read(int fd,char * buffer,unsigned size,int options)
methods.description: Reads a packet and returns its length.

methods.name: char * packet_read_line(int fd,int * dst_len)
methods.description: Reads a line packet, chomps newline.

methods.name: int packet_read_line_gently(int fd,int * dst_len,char ** dst_line)
methods.description: Reads a line packet gently.

methods.name: ssize_t read_packetized_to_strbuf(int fd_in,struct strbuf * sb_out,int options)
methods.description: Reads packetized data into a strbuf, handling multiple packets.

methods.name: int recv_sideband(const char * me,int in_stream,int out)
methods.description: Receives sideband data from stream and demultiplexes it to output.

methods.name: void packet_reader_init(struct packet_reader * reader,int fd,char * src_buffer,size_t src_len,int options)
methods.description: Initializes a packet_reader structure with fd, buffers, options.

methods.name: enum:packet_read_status packet_reader_read(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Performs a read cycle in packet_reader, handling sideband and progress.

methods.name: enum:packet_read_status packet_reader_peek(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Peeks at the next packet without advancing.

methods.name: void packet_writer_init(struct packet_writer * writer,int dest_fd)
methods.description: Initializes a packet_writer with destination fd.

methods.name: void packet_writer_write(struct packet_writer * writer,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Writes a formatted packet to the writer’s fd.

methods.name: void packet_writer_error(struct packet_writer * writer,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Writes an error packet.

methods.name: void packet_writer_delim(struct packet_writer * writer)
methods.description: Writes a delimiter packet.

methods.name: void packet_writer_flush(struct packet_writer * writer)
methods.description: Flushes the writer’s packets.
